# Subway Seat for Prism

A Prism stylesheet per flavor, using the same syntax colours as the editor themes.

[Prism](https://prismjs.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/prism/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.css`](subway-seat.css) | your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat.css |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.css`](subway-seat-tunnel.css) | your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-tunnel.css |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.css`](subway-seat-enamel.css) | your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-enamel.css |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock Prism theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat.css">
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock Prism theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat-tunnel.css">
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock Prism theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat-enamel.css">
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
